steps.npc: Do you have any gold ore that you want me to take to the bank in the city?

steps.text: If the player has no gold ore:

steps.player: I don't have any, I'm afraid.

steps.text: If the player has 1 gold ore:

steps.player: Well, I have this one piece of ore...

steps.npc: That wouldn't do you much good, I'm afraid. My minimum fee is one piece of gold ore, there wouldn't be anything left for you.

options.text: Yes, please take my gold to the city.

steps.player: Yes, please take my gold to the city. I've got [number] pieces of ore right here.

steps.text: If the player does not have sufficient bank space or is an Ultimate Ironman:

steps.npc: Are you sure you have enough space in your bank account for that?

steps.player: No, you're right actually, I don't.

steps.npc: Let's see, if I take that to the bank for you, I'd keep [number] for myself and bring [number] to the bank for you. Does that sound fair?
Excellent, it's been good doing business with you! I'll take these to the city with my next shipment.

steps.player: No, that's far too expensive for me.

options.text: No, I'll hang on to these myself.

steps.player: No, I'll hang on to these myself, thanks.

options.text: [Charm] It all seems a bit expensive, really.
options.condition: If the player is wearing the Ring of Charos(a):

steps.player: It all seems a bit expensive, really.

steps.npc: I don't know... it's just what Dondakan told me, if someone wanted me to ship their gold.

steps.player: There's plenty of gold coming from that rock now, surely you can lower the price somewhat?

steps.npc: Alright. Tell you what, I'll only keep [number] for myself and bring [number] ores to the bank for you. Deal?
Excellent, it's been good doing business with you!

steps.player: No, I'll hang on to these myself, thanks.
